about: Verdicts on words where morphhb's text, which is WLC 4.20's, and MAM differ, for gh-pages/morphhb-corrections/index.html. Written by Claude (Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-16 for Ben Denckla.

Claude's re-judging of 2026-11-16, which applied these definitions to every word that the report of 2026-11-13 judged, whether its methods found the word or its brief named it, and to the rare pairs that its general test listed but that it did not judge. Each word's "source" says which; its "report" is the report's own verdict (for a word that only its brief named, the class it gave that word's case, unless the forms agree), or "none".

Each word: morphhb's id, its verse, morphhb's text (WLC 4.20's form, with morphhb's morpheme slashes) and MAM's atom, both in MAM-normal mark order and copied by script from the report's data; morphhb's lemma and morph; the report's own verdict; how the word came to be judged, where the file records it; the verdict here; and its reason.

verdicts.defies: WLC 4.20's form, as written, is a regular spelling of some word or inflection, and morphhb's lemma or morph reads another.
verdicts.resolves: WLC 4.20's form, as written, is a regular spelling of no word or inflection in its place (a mark is missing, contradicts another or stands where none can), or of more than one where the marks or letters in which it differs from MAM's form make it so, and morphhb's lemma and morph read it as one.
verdicts.follows: morphhb's lemma and morph read WLC 4.20's form as written, where MAM's form would be analysed otherwise.
verdicts.slip: morphhb's lemma or morph fits no reading of WLC 4.20's form and does not read MAM's form either.
verdicts.fits both: morphhb's lemma and morph read WLC 4.20's form as written, and would read MAM's form the same way: the forms differ in marks that neither the lemma nor the morph encodes.
verdicts.ketiv: the word is a ketiv, and the difference is in how it is written or pointed, or in how morphhb analyses it.
verdicts.same: WLC 4.20's form and MAM's agree in letters and points: there is nothing to judge.
verdicts.text: the difference lies in morphhb's text against WLC 4.20's, which the page treats in its own section: the two accentuations of the Decalogues and Genesis 35:22, an atom that morphhb divides in two, or Daniel 2:39's ketiv and qere.
